name: Camp Uncommon
description_short: Two week sleepaway camp at Camp Powhatan in Otisfield for students of Uncommon Schools in Boston, Camden, Newark, New York City and Rochester entering grades 4 to 9; it is not open to other children. Campers rotate through sports, swimming, arts, STEM and nature, pick two intensives each session and ride a camp bus from their city.
